system.description:
Six-fingered prince of pleasure and betrayal. His court is built entirely on seduction.

  • Patron boon: Once a day, reroll a failed Charisma check, and you know what a creature finds most desirable in you.

Allegiance: Chaotic Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Graz'zt in the World of Arneyan wiki.
